# Kahvi

Coffee: roasted beans, ground, met with hot water. Brewing it every morning
is the procedure in [Kahvin keitto](../skills/kahvin-keitto.md); the water
comes from [Veden keitto](../skills/veden-keitto.md). When someone knocks, the
host follows [Vieraat](vieraat.md).
